name: DNA Hamming Distance
description: Count mismatches between two equal-length DNA sequences. Hamming distance is the simplest sequence divergence metric — two sequences at Hamming distance k differ at exactly k positions. Used in alignment seeding, primer design, and mutation rate estimation. The DNA_HAMMING tile compares packed base-pair words in parallel; mismatches are OR-reduced to a count.
author: system

pipeline.note: XOR packed words, popcount mismatches, sum — all in parallel across words

validation: Two identical sequences → 0. Complement of ATGC (TACG) → 4 mismatches in 4 bases. Random sequences of length n over 4-base alphabet → expected n*3/4 mismatches.
